theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : Set (Rn N)) (ρ : Rn N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet G volume → ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → ∀ x w : Rn N, fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ ∫ z in G, ρ (x - z)) x w = ∫ z in G, fderiv ℝ ρ (x - z) w
